title: feat: wire userFilters through NamedListView type, config panel, and preview passthrough
body:
`userFilters` (Airtable Interfaces-style dropdown/tabs/toggle filter controls) existed on `ListViewSchema` and rendered in `plugin-list`, but was missing from `NamedListView`, the config panel, and both ObjectView passthrough paths — so it couldn't be configured or persisted. ### Type parity - Added `userFilters` to `NamedListView` in `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` via `ListViewSchema['userFilters']` to avoid inline duplication and prevent type drift. ### Schema passthrough - **Console `ObjectView.tsx`**: `userFilters: viewDef.userFilters ?? listSchema.userFilters` in `renderListView` fullSchema construction. - **Plugin-view `ObjectView.tsx`**: `userFilters: activeView?.userFilters ?? (schema as any).userFilters` in `renderContent`. ### Config panel UI - Added `_userFilters` custom field in `buildDataSection` (after `_quickFilters`): - Element type selector: three styled buttons for `dropdown` / `tabs` / `toggle` - **Dropdown/toggle mode**: field picker via ``, default tab checkbox, `showAllRecords` toggle (defaults to checked, matching runtime behavior where `showAllRecords !== false`), `allowAddTab` toggle - Conditional rendering switches between field picker and tab editor based on selected element type - `ExpandableWidget` with comma-joined field/tab label summary - All mutations via `updateField('userFilters', ...)` → draft → live preview ### i18n - 10 new keys in `en.ts` / `zh.ts`: `ufElements`, `ufDropdown`, `ufTabs`, `ufToggle`, `ufAddField`, `ufNoFields`, `ufAddTab`, `ufTabLabel`, `ufShowAllRecords`, `ufAllowAddTab`. ### Tests - `view-config-schema.test.tsx`: field key order updated, `_userFilters` existence + ordering assertions. - Console `ObjectView.test.tsx`: mock renders `schema-userFilters`, passthrough test from `listViews[].userFilters`. - Plugin-view `ObjectView.test.tsx`: propagation test from `activeView.userFilters`. - `ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx`: 8 new tests — editor rendering, element type switching, field add/remove, tabs section rendering, tab add/remove/edit label. - All 477 tests pass across 6 affected test files.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 修复和补全 User Filters 筛选字段面板配置与预览链路（Airtable模式/Spec协议全链路覆盖） > # 面板可配置 User Filters、左侧预览生效、配置可保存全链路修复 > > **目标：实现与 Airtable Interfaces 风格一致的用户筛选字段配置功能**。确保 CRM/业务对象视图可以在配置面板中选择筛选字段，编辑和保存后左侧预览即时生效，且永久保存于视图定义。 > > --- > > ## 开发任务清单 > > ### 1. 类型定义补齐 > - [ ] 在 `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` 的 `NamedListView` 类型中补充 `userFilters?: ...`，严格保持与 `ListViewSchema` 属性一致。 > > ### 2. Console ObjectView 透传 userFilters > - [ ] 在 `apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx` 的 `renderListView` 构造 fullSchema 时，将 `userFilters` 从 `viewDef`/`listSchema`传递给 ``。 > > ### 3. 配置面板 UI > - [ ] 在 `apps/console/src/utils/view-config-schema.tsx` 增加 `buildUserFiltersSection` 和相关交互： > - dropdown/tabs/toggle 元素类型选择。 > - 可视化选择/排序筛选字段、配置 tab。 > - 实时推送到 draft.userFilters，设计与 `quickFilters` 编辑体验一致。 > > ### 4. i18n 国际化 > - [ ] 补充 en/zh keys：userFilters、元素类型、dropdowns、tabs、无可用字段提示 > > ### 5. 测试覆盖 > - [ ] `ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx`/`ObjectView.test.tsx`/ > plugin-list `ListView.test.tsx`: > - 能编辑 userFilters 元素/字段/tab，并推送到 draft/viewDef > - 配置变更，左侧预览 toolbar badge 实时变化 > - 配置保存后，下次打开视图配置生效 > > ### 6. PluginObjectView 组件透传 > - [ ] 在 `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` （如用到 renderListView schema 构造），确保 `userFilters` 也能透传 > > --- > > ## 验收标准 > - [ ] 面板右侧能够完整配置筛选字段，元素类型为 dropdown/tabs/toggle 均有效果 > - [ ] 配置后左侧列表工具栏实时展示筛选 badge，并可交互过滤 > - [ ] 保存后刷新页面、切换视图配置信息不丢失 > - [ ] 相关 i18n/测试覆盖完整 > - [ ] 符合 ROADMAP.md Airtable Parity 节点要求 > > --- > > （如需其他 repo 配合可 cross-repo 创建 issue） > > 关联截图： > > > > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
